picks.headline: ChatGPT Vulnerability Allowed Account Takeover via Malicious Share URLs
picks.why: Parameter Labs identified an attack chain in ChatGPT that permitted full account compromise and exfiltration via shared context links.
picks.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts

picks.headline: Activation Probing Detects Multi-Agent Secret Leaks Before Generation Begins
picks.why: Linear probes on intermediate model activations can catch target agents right before they leak secrets to peers, outperforming output-level LLM monitors.
picks.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In

picks.headline: Speculative Decoding Energy Savings Invert Under Large Production Batches
picks.why: Benchmarking reveals that speculative decoding turns from an energy saver into a net energy loss as batch sizes scale or acceptance rates drop.
picks.title: Only Accepted Tokens Count: An Energy Accounting of Speculative Decoding Under Latency Targets

picks.headline: BPE Tokenizers Leak Pre-Training Dataset Membership via Rare Tokens
picks.why: Rare byte-pair encoding tokens act as persistent artifacts that reveal training set membership without requiring direct model weight access.
picks.title: Tokenizer Tokens Tell Training Tales

papers.headline: Cognitive Memory Toolset Cuts Agent Token Usage 6x
papers.why: Enables long-horizon LLM agents to self-checkpoint progress and flush past context without degrading task success.
papers.title: Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation

papers.headline: Glance Unifies Generation and Reranking Using Shared Prefill Adapters
papers.why: Eliminates separate reranker models by scoring candidate passages directly inside the main generator prefill phase.
papers.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker

papers.headline: Synthetic Pre-Pretraining Offers No Benefit Over Pure Natural Language
papers.why: Demonstrates that compute-matched synthetic pre-training fails to outperform standard pre-training when accounting for baseline weight initialization.
papers.title: Rethinking Pre-pretraining
